videos.headline: Devon Jackson takes it coast-to-coast for a 96-yard Oregon pick-six
Oregon gets great field position after Matayo Uiagalelei's INT
Drew Mestemaker, Wyatt Young link up for a 52-yard Oklahoma State TD
Caleb Hawkins finds the end zone for 5-yard TD
Gage Hurych drills a 42-yard field goal for Oregon
Jordon Davison cuts into Oklahoma State's lead with a short TD
Dante Moore airs out a 36-yard TD pass to Dakorien Moore
Evan Stewart shows off some moves en route to a go-ahead TD for Oregon
Drew Mestemaker goes airborne for wild Oklahoma State TD
Oregon's 4th-down gamble doesn't pay off as Texas A&M gets ball back
Oklahoma State fans take down goalpost after knocking off Oregon
